svg.title: Fast flow versus default
svg.desc: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor, warm runs, 26–27 September 2026. Small fixtures, 13 tasks. Default flow: mean 38.8 seconds, 39 of 39 passed. Fast flow: mean 19.4 seconds, 39 of 39 passed. Real repositories, 6 tasks. Default flow: mean 66.2 seconds, 18 of 18 passed. Fast flow: mean 33.2 seconds, 18 of 18 passed. Means only; uncertainty intervals were not recorded. Cold results differ. Source: research/06-optimisation-stage-summary.md#headline.
